text: Si tawii morlooɗe ɗen huuɓirii ɓe kala bannge, wa'ii wa pelle maa duule, ɓe nodday Alla tun, ɓe laɓɓinana Mo dewal e toraare; tuma nde O jaabinani ɓe, O daɗndi ɓe yoolagol, O naɓiri ɓe ka njorndi, tawi no e maɓɓe hakindiiɗo: mo waɗaali ko waɗɗii mo kon e yettugol neema on no haaniri, woɗɓe goo yeddi neema on few. Awa yeddataa Aayeeje Amen ɗen, - si wanaa kala heewuɗo janfa, sifa on ahodunooɗo e Alla, wonnde pellet, si O danɗndii mo, o tawete e yettooɓe Mo ɓen -, dullanoowo neemaaji Alla ɗin, mo yettataa Joomi mun e neema Makko on.
